basic_info.description: 2-Unit condo | This well maintained 2-unit condo offers a rare opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors. Each spacious unit features: 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a formal living, dining room, kitchen, fireplace, and in-unit laundry. Ground floor offers a bonus studio unit. This home showcases hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchens and bathrooms, and double-pane windows for modern comfort. There is no HOA, self-managed. Spacious two-car side-by-side garage with generous storage and additional laundry area. Perfect for multi-generational living, a live-rent arrangement, or a full investment strategy. Located just steps from Golden Gate Park, UCSF, public transit (N-Muni, L-Muni, 7, 48, 28 and more!), restaurants, shops, and parks, this home blends the best of city living with a peaceful neighborhood vibe.
